ideas.pitch: An intelligent water resource and asset management dashboard for local administrative bodies, combining GIS mapping and automated tracking inspired by national hackathon winners.
ideas.title: JalSanchay AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the successful pattern of JalSetu from Smart India Hackathon by solving a practical bureaucratic and rural resource management problem with clear measurable impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered institutional room booking and event space management platform that automates facility utilization tracking and scheduling for large campuses like G.L. Bajaj.
ideas.title: CampusFlow Workspace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the runner-up strategy of SpaceFlow at SmartHack'25 by targeting administrative and institutional workflows that judges immediately understand and appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A civic-tech walk-to-earn mobile application that incentivizes citizens to report civic issues like potholes and street light failures while integrating a live municipal tracking dashboard.
ideas.title: NagrikAur
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of Catwalk from Chatswood AI Hackathon, combining gamified user engagement with practical real-world municipal infrastructure tracking.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven waste management monitoring platform utilizing computer vision to optimize campus waste collection schedules and educate students on proper segregation.
ideas.title: GreenCampus WasteAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds upon the success of EcoSaathi by adding a modern computer vision layer for automated waste audit reports, appealing directly to sustainability priorities.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG student support platform tailored specifically for college societies and administrative queries, offering instant guidance on campus events and rules.
ideas.title: VibeAssist Academic Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the multi-agent architecture that won the GreenNovation Hackathon, providing an impressive technical demonstration using LangGraph and localized RAG.
